title: Spatial Pattern Decoding of Imagined Hand Movements: A Fictional Baseline
abstract: We study motor imagery decoding with Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) features and a linear discriminant analysis (LDA) classifier. Experiments on BCI Competition IV 2a (22 EEG channels, sampled at 250 Hz) give a mean accuracy of 71.2%.

title: A Compact Convolutional Network for Imagined Movement (Synthetic Example)
abstract: We train EEGNet for motor imagery classification on BCI Competition IV 2a using 22 EEG channels sampled at 250 Hz. The network reaches 76.8% accuracy and a kappa of 0.69 in within-subject evaluation.

title: Filter-Bank Features with Margin Classifiers: A Made-up Study
abstract: A filter bank common spatial patterns (FBCSP) pipeline feeds a support vector machine (SVM) for motor imagery decoding. Evaluation on BCI Competition IV 2a and BCI Competition IV 2b yields an accuracy of 74.5%.

title: Tree Ensembles and Rule-Based Reasoning for Movement Imagery (Fictional)
abstract: We compare a random forest with a fuzzy classifier for motor imagery on the PhysioNet EEGMMIDB recordings (64 channels, sampled at 160 Hz). The fuzzy classifier is more interpretable; the best accuracy was 68.9%.

title: Convolutional Decoding of Character Selection Signals (Synthetic)
abstract: EEGNet is applied to a P300 speller task on the BNCI Horizon 2020 P300 recordings with 8 channels sampled at 256 Hz. We report 91.3% accuracy and an AUC of 0.95.

title: Denoising Speller Epochs with a Learned Projection (Imaginary Work)
abstract: xDAWN, a spatial filter, enhances evoked responses before an LDA classifier in a P300 speller on the BNCI Horizon 2020 P300 recordings (8 channels, sampled at 256 Hz). Accuracy of 88.0% is obtained.

title: Frequency-Tagged Target Recognition by Correlation (Fictional Report)
abstract: Canonical correlation analysis (CCA) recognises SSVEP targets on the Benchmark SSVEP dataset with 64 channels sampled at 250 Hz. The system reaches 84.1% accuracy and an ITR of 120.5 bits/min.

title: Deep and Shallow Learners for Flicker-Evoked Responses (Synthetic)
abstract: We evaluate EEGNet and an SVM for SSVEP classification on the Benchmark SSVEP dataset (64 channels, sampled at 250 Hz). EEGNet gives 89.6% accuracy, ahead of the SVM.

title: Manifold Features Across Two Brain Signal Types (Made-up)
abstract: Riemannian tangent space features with an SVM are tested on two paradigms: motor imagery from BCI Competition IV 2a and a P300 speller on BNCI Horizon 2020 P300. Accuracy of 77.9% is reported on the motor imagery data.

title: Two Convolutional Baselines on a Large Imagery Cohort (Fictional)
abstract: ShallowConvNet and DeepConvNet are compared for motor imagery on OpenBMI (62 channels, sampled at 1000 Hz). The best model achieved 72.4% accuracy.

title: Attention Over Sensorimotor Epochs (Synthetic Example)
abstract: A Transformer encoder decodes motor imagery on BCI Competition IV 2a with 22 channels sampled at 250 Hz, reaching 80.1% accuracy.

title: Interpretable Rules over Spatial Features for Hand Imagery (Fictional)
abstract: CSP features are combined with a fuzzy classifier for motor imagery on BCI Competition III IVa (118 channels, sampled at 100 Hz). The accuracy was 79.3%.
